card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is still unfinished, such as aberr (aberrations), depress (depressants) and aspir (aspirin). It is mostly seen in drug-label text on CNS depressants.

modes.label: CNS depressants
modes.description: The stem depress before -ant(s) after 'CNS' in warnings about combining opioids with other drugs.
modes.example: or other CNS<< depress>>ants (including alcohol and illicit drugs).

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: Word starts such as aberr or aspir that need an ending to finish the word.

card.plain: It fires on the opening chunk of a long word, like depress in CNS depressants, when the rest of the word is still to come.
evidence: or other CNS<< depress>>ants (including alcohol and illicit drugs).
